title: Rabbi Yochanan Antnayta

paragraphs: A precious saying of his survives in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1: “It is an established covenant: one who labors at his learning does not quickly forget it.”[^1]

notes.text: Hyman gives the heading Yochanan Antnayta. The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1 paragraph distinguishes Rabbi Yochanan’s saying about learning in the synagogue from a saying about learning privately attributed there to bracketed Rabbi Chanina Entenaya. Both concern not quickly forgetting. This comparison does not establish Hyman’s combined name form or identify those speakers with one another.
